column1: # Encyclopedia profile pictures: unit id, gallery photo, verdict of a visual check
# (two independent reviewers looked at the photo, a third settled disagreements;
# same_type and same_family are built, wrong_subject and unusable are not). 5 Oct 2026.

column4: note
Large military camp of tan shelter tents/huts; representative of tents, not a four-tent cluster. / Large military camp of beige frame tents, much bigger than a four-tent group.

Small seized narco semi-submersible with an LCS and helicopter behind; the unit is a much larger fully-submersible narco-sub. / A small semi-submersible narco craft with outboard motors, intercepted by an LCS; the unit is a 58 m fully-submersible 'advanced' narco-sub.
JASDF F-2B two-seat trainer (23-8108) on approach, not the single-seat F-2A. / Two-seat JASDF F-2B (23-8108, tandem canopy), not the single-seat F-2A.

Australian Centurion tank displayed at the Australian War Memorial, hull and turret fully visible. / Australian Centurion with the 20-pdr gun (fume extractor near muzzle) at the Australian War Memorial.
Spanish carrier Dedalo (ex-Independence class) underway with AV-8 Matadors and helicopters on deck. / Spanish carrier Dedalo (R01) underway in 1988 with Harriers and helicopters on deck.

USS Oliver Hazard Perry (FFG-7), short-hull lead ship, parent class of the Spanish Santa Maria class. / Shows USS Oliver Hazard Perry (FFG-7), the US short-hull lead ship in 1977, not a Spanish long-hull Santa Maria-class with Meroka.

USS Oliver Hazard Perry (FFG-7), short-hull US parent class of the Santa Maria class. / Shows USS Oliver Hazard Perry (FFG-7), the US short-hull lead ship in 1977, not a Spanish long-hull Santa Maria-class in late fit.
Dutch F-104G Starfighter (D-8030) on a gate-guard mound. / A Dutch F-104G Starfighter (D-8030) displayed on a grass mound.
Dutch F-104G Starfighter (D-8030); an earlier variant that looks broadly the same as the F-104S. / A Dutch F-104G, a closely related earlier variant, not an Italian F-104S.
Dutch F-104G Starfighter (D-8030); an earlier variant that looks broadly the same as the F-104S.ASA. / A Dutch F-104G, a closely related earlier variant, not an F-104S.ASA.

RAF Tornado F3 (ADV) banking, underside view showing its long nose and semi-recessed missile stations. / RAF Tornado F3 (ADV) underside, showing the long radome and semi-recessed fuselage missile stations.
German Tornado IDS in a special anniversary livery in flight; ECR-specific features are not shown. / German Tornado IDS 43+92 in a special livery, an IDS rather than the ECR variant.
German Tornado IDS in a special anniversary livery in flight. / German Tornado IDS 43+92 in a special anniversary livery, in flight.
German Tornado IDS in a special anniversary livery in flight. / German Tornado IDS 43+92 in a special anniversary livery, in flight.
Geared bulk carrier with four deck cranes moored at a loading jetty. / Bulk carrier Sea Etiquette with four deck cranes at the Kwinana bulk terminal.
Head-on photo of a grey RAAF KC-30A (A330 MRTT) with underwing refuelling pods, taxiing. / RAAF KC-30A (A330 MRTT) seen head-on with its underwing refuelling pods.
Australian Army Tiger ARH (A38-018) on static display behind cones. / Australian Army Tiger ARH (A38-018) in camouflage on static display.
Dutch NH90 NFH (325) parked; same naval NH90 airframe, Dutch markings. / Dutch NH90 NFH naval helicopter; same type as Belgian naval NH90.
Head-on view of a grey Airbus A400M Atlas on the ramp. / Airbus A400M Atlas head-on on the apron (Airbus-grey test aircraft).
Head-on view of an A400M Atlas; same airframe as the tanker role. / Airbus A400M Atlas airframe head-on; the tanker role is a fit difference only.
RC-135V Rivet Joint with original TF33 engines, not the modern re-engined CFM56 configuration. / Legacy TF33-engined RC-135V, not the modern re-engined RC-135V/W with larger CFM56 nacelles.
RC-135V Rivet Joint with original TF33 engines and cheek fairings: the legacy configuration. / Legacy TF33-engined RC-135V Rivet Joint with hog nose and cheek fairings.
Grey A330 MRTT tanker head-on (RAAF KC-30A); same airframe, different operator. / A330 MRTT tanker seen head-on; the operator differs but the airframe is the same.

NAe Sao Paulo (A12) broadside in the foreground, with USS Ronald Reagan behind. / NAe São Paulo (A12), ex-Clemenceau-class carrier, in full side view in the foreground, with USS Ronald Reagan in the background.
Brazilian submarine Riachuelo (S40) surfaced off Rio de Janeiro. / Brazilian submarine Riachuelo (S40) surfaced off Rio de Janeiro.

Brazilian Tupi-class submarine S30 surfaced; Tikuna is the enlarged derivative. / Brazilian Tupi-class S30 (Type 209/1400) surfaced; Tikuna is a modified, slightly enlarged derivative that looks broadly the same.
Brazilian Tupi-class submarine S30 surfaced underway. / Tupi-class submarine S30 surfaced underway off Rio, with the hull and sail clearly visible.
HMS Cumberland (F85), a Type 22 Batch 3, not a Batch 1 Greenhalgh-class ship. / RN Type 22 Batch 3 HMS Cumberland, not the ex-Batch 1 Greenhalgh-class fit or operator.
Marder 1A3 IFV with foliage camouflage driving on a dusty track (front view). / A Marder 1A3 in Ukrainian service, partly covered in foliage, driving on a training ground.
Czech Leopard 2A4 MBT front view at a public display, visitors at edges. / Czech Leopard 2A4 MBT seen from the front at a public display.
Bundeswehr Gepard SPAAG with twin 35 mm guns and search radar. / A German Gepard anti-aircraft tank with twin 35 mm guns and its radars.
Bundeswehr Gepard SPAAG; the sub-variant cannot be told apart in the photo, but it looks the same. / A German Gepard anti-aircraft tank; the 1A2 upgrade looks externally the same.

Pair of French Air Force Mirage 2000D two-seat strike jets; related to the Brazilian 2000B trainer. / Pair of French Mirage 2000D two-seat strike jets. Related to the 2000B trainer but a different variant.

Head-on Ukrainian Mirage 2000-5F under camo netting; 2000C looks broadly the same. / Head-on view of a Ukrainian single-seat Mirage 2000-5F with blue/yellow drop tanks; same Mirage 2000 family, but not the 2000C flown by Brazil.

Australian Tiger ARH with roof sight and chin gun; German Tigers (UHT) have a mast sight and no gun. / Australian Tiger ARH in Australian camouflage and markings; same Tiger family, but a different variant and operator from the German Tiger (UHT has a mast-mounted sight).
Grey A330 MRTT tanker head-on (RAAF KC-30A); same airframe as CC-330, different operator. / A330 MRTT tanker seen head-on; same airframe as the CC-330 Husky.
Complete Canberra bomber on static display. / Complete RAAF Canberra B.20 bomber on static display.
Museum M113 APC, front view with the engine access hatch open. / M113 APC in a museum with engine access hatch open and info board in front.

USAF E-3 Sentry with TF33 engines; E-3D has larger CFM56 engines but looks broadly the same. / USAF E-3 Sentry with narrow TF33 engines, seen from above; same AWACS family, but the E-3D has larger CFM56 nacelles and RAF markings.
HMS Cumberland (F85), a Type 22 Batch 3, not the Chilean Batch 2 Barak refit. / RN Type 22 Batch 3 HMS Cumberland, not the Chilean Batch 2 ship with its Barak refit.
Lufthansa Airbus A320-200 climbing out, clear side-underside view. / Lufthansa Airbus A320-200 (D-AIQT) climbing out after takeoff.
bmi Airbus A330-200 taxiing, full side view. / bmi Airbus A330-200 airliner taxiing.
Emirates Airbus A380 taking off past an airport control tower. / Emirates Airbus A380 taking off, with an airport tower behind.
Toyota-type pickup technical with an anti-aircraft autocannon and gunner in the bed. / Toyota Land Cruiser pickup technical with ZU-23-2 mount and gunner.

Pickup technical with a ZU-23 autocannon; same vehicle, but the BMP-2 turret armament is not shown.
Pickup technical with a ZU-23 autocannon; same vehicle, but Stinger armament is not shown.
Pickup technical with heavier AA autocannon rather than an M2 machine gun. / Gun-armed pickup technical, but the mount is a ZU-23 autocannon rather than an M2 machine gun.
Pickup technical with a ZU-23 autocannon; same vehicle, but the M224 mortar is not shown.
Gun-armed AA technical, not an ambulance/medic pickup. / Shows an armed ZU-23 gun technical, not an unarmed ambulance-converted pickup.
Pickup technical with a ZU-23 autocannon; same vehicle, but Strela-2 armament is not shown.
Pickup technical with a ZU-23 autocannon; same vehicle, but the TOW launcher is not shown.
Modern civilian beam trawler White Horse beached in surf, not a naval anti-submarine trawler. / The photo shows an unarmed civilian beam trawler, not a naval anti-submarine trawler.
Small European steel trawler White Horse (beam-trawl derricks raised) of similar size; broadly similar to the generic 30 m small side trawler, though the rig differs.
Civilian beam trawler White Horse beached in surf; a generic small fishing vessel. / A small civilian beam trawler works only as a generic fishing-boat photo; no armament is shown.

Civilian beam trawler with outrigger derricks, not a purse seiner. / The photo shows a beam trawler with trawl booms, not a seiner; the rig visibly differs (between same_family and wrong_subject, so wrong_subject was chosen).
Small civilian beam trawler, not a large Okean-type ocean-going side trawler. / The photo shows a small Belgian beam trawler, not the much larger Soviet Okean-class side trawler or intelligence ship.
Civilian beam trawler with outrigger derricks, not a seiner. / The photo shows a beam trawler with outrigger booms, which matches neither the seiner label nor the side-trawler hull.
Aeroflot-liveried Il-76MD (RA-78791) parked; same airframe as the civil Il-76T. / Il-76MD (nose marked ИЛ-76МД, RA-78791) in Aeroflot livery; military variant of the civil Il-76T.
Aeroflot-liveried Il-76MD (RA-78791) parked; same airframe as the civil Il-76TD. / Il-76MD (nose marked ИЛ-76МД) in Aeroflot livery; military counterpart of the civil Il-76TD.
Generic Yang Ming Line container ship underway, not an ACT 1-class vessel. / Modern Yang Ming Line container ship with name on hull, not the ACT 1 class.

Modern gearless short-sea coaster 'Kristina', not a crane-equipped Swan Hunter general cargo ship. / Modern gearless short-sea coaster 'Kristina'; the Amra class is a 143 m 1970s British general cargo ship with its own cranes.

Modern gearless coaster 'Kristina', not a 1950s East German-built Andizhan-class freighter with derricks. / Modern gearless coaster with open box hold; the Andizhan class is a late-1950s East German-built break-bulk freighter with derricks.
Modern gearless coaster 'Kristina', not a C4-class general cargo ship. / Modern gearless coaster; the unit is a WWII/1950s-era US C4 cargo liner with a midships superstructure and derricks.
Modern gearless coaster 'Kristina', not an Improved C4-class general cargo ship. / Modern gearless coaster; the unit is a 180 m Improved C4 (Seamaster) steam cargo liner with derricks.

Small modern gearless coaster, not a large crane-equipped general cargo freighter. / Gearless short-sea coaster; the unit is a 157 m geared general cargo ship whose defining feature is its own cranes, which this photo lacks.
Modern gearless coaster 'Kristina', not a crane-equipped Soviet Irkutsk-class cargo ship. / Small modern gearless coaster; the Irkutsk class is a 151 m Soviet cargo ship with its own cranes.

Modern gearless coaster 'Kristina', not a 12,000-ton Soviet Kommunist-class freighter with cargo gear. / Small modern gearless coaster; the Kommunist class is a 155 m Soviet-era geared break-bulk freighter.

A generic Yang Ming Line container ship under way; it is a container ship but not the Mairangi Bay class itself. / Modern Yang Ming Line container ship at sea; the same ship type and layout as the late-1970s Mairangi Bay container ship, but a different class.

Modern gearless coaster 'Kristina', not a Soviet Metallurg Anosov-class (Project 567) cargo ship with standalone cranes. / Small modern gearless coaster; the Metallurg Anosov (Project 567) is a 170 m 1960s Soviet steam cargo ship with heavy derricks.
Modern gearless coaster 'Kristina', not a Soviet Murom-class general cargo ship with cargo gear. / Small modern gearless coaster; the Murom class is a 155 m Soviet-era geared general cargo ship.

Modern gearless coaster 'Kristina', not a Poltava-class freighter with heavy-lift derricks. / The coaster shares an aft superstructure but has no cargo gear; the Poltava class is a 156 m freighter defined by its heavy-lift derricks.
Soviet passenger cruise-ferry with lifeboats and passengers, not a medium cargo RORO with bow ramp. / Soviet passenger cruise ferry Lev Tolstoy, not the Ivan Skuridin-type bow-ramp cargo RORO.
Modern gearless coaster 'Kristina', not a five-hold Soviet Slavyansk-class cargo ship. / Small modern gearless coaster; the Slavyansk class is a 153 m late-1960s Soviet five-hold geared cargo ship.

A modern cellular container ship, while Super P is a 1960s crane-equipped general cargo liner. / Fully cellular container ship, but the Super P class is a late-1960s geared break-bulk cargo liner with cranes, not a container ship.

Modern small coaster with its bridge aft; broadly like the small Romanian Yuniy Partizan coastal cargo ships, but not that class. / Small aft-bridge coaster of similar size and layout to the 89 m Romanian-built Yuniy Partizan coastal freighter, but a modern ship of a different class.
Grey A330 MRTT tanker head-on (RAAF KC-30A); same airframe, different operator. / A330 MRTT tanker seen head-on; same airframe as the KC-330.
Dutch NH90 NFH (325) parked; German naval NH90 (Sea Lion/Sea Tiger) differs in fit. / Dutch NH90 NFH naval helicopter; German naval NH90 differs only in fit.
Royal Navy Lynx HAS.3 in a museum; the Mk88A is the later Super Lynx standard. / Royal Navy Lynx HAS.3 museum exhibit with the early nose; the Mk88A has the Super Lynx chin radar.
US Navy MH-60R Seahawk hovering over the sea; same type as the Danish unit, different operator. / US Navy MH-60R Seahawk; Danish MH-60R is the same type with a different operator.
Saab GlobalEye with Erieye ER radar beam on a Global 6000 airframe, side view. / Saab GlobalEye with its Erieye ER radar on top, landing.
Pair of French Mirage 2000D two-seaters; related to the Egyptian 2000BM trainer. / Pair of French Mirage 2000D two-seaters, not the Egyptian 2000BM trainer, though it looks broadly the same.
Qatari two-seat Mirage 2000-5 in flight; an early-model Mirage 2000 looks broadly the same. / Qatari two-seat Mirage 2000-5 in flight, not the single-seat 2000EM.

Soldier on a pedestal-mounted Mistral MANPADS launcher at a parade, not the SIDAM 25 tracked SPAAG. / Mistral missile on a soldier-operated tripod launcher at a parade, not the SIDAM 25 M113-based SPAAG.
German Eurofighter Typhoon (30+68) in special Luftwaffe display livery, climbing. / Single-seat Eurofighter Typhoon (German 30+68, Luftwaffe special livery) climbing.
German Eurofighter Typhoon (30+68) in special Luftwaffe display livery, climbing. / Single-seat Eurofighter Typhoon in German special livery; same airframe, different paint.
French Air Force two-seat Rafale B on approach with gear down. / French Air Force two-seat Rafale B on approach with gear down.
French Air Force two-seat Rafale B on approach with gear down. / Two-seat Rafale B airframe; the later standard looks the same from outside.

Single-seat Rafale in blue display livery climbing on afterburner, seen from behind. / Single-seat Rafale in the French solo display livery, seen from below and behind with afterburners lit; airframe matches, but the livery is French.

Single-seat Rafale in blue display livery climbing on afterburner, seen from behind. / Single-seat Rafale C in a display livery seen from below and behind; the late-standard fit cannot be verified, but it is the same airframe type.
French Navy Rafale M '37' on approach with gear down; the export operator differs. / French Navy Rafale M (37) on approach with gear and refuelling probe out.
French Navy Rafale M '37' on approach with gear down; the late export fit is not visibly distinct. / French Navy Rafale M (37) on approach. A later standard looks the same airframe at a glance.
Pair of French Mirage 2000D two-seaters; related to the Peruvian 2000DP trainer. / Pair of French Mirage 2000D two-seaters, not the Peruvian 2000DP trainer, though it looks broadly the same.
Qatari two-seat Mirage 2000-5 in flight; the single-seat Mirage 2000P looks broadly the same. / Qatari two-seat Mirage 2000-5, not the single-seat 2000P.
German Army NH90 TTH hovering over troops and vehicles. / German Army NH90 TTH in camouflage hovering over troops; same type, different operator.

Only a disassembled RN Sea Venom nose/cockpit pod with exposed engine; wings and twin booms absent. / Disassembled RN Sea Venom FAW.22 nose section only; aircraft not recognisably whole and not an Aquilon.

Royal Saudi Navy AS565 Panther (Dauphin naval) with a nose radome, landing on a ship deck. / Royal Saudi Navy AS365/AS565 Dauphin/Panther with nose radome, landing on a ship deck; the subtype is unresolved and no weapons are fitted.
French Navy Atlantique 2 on the ground, side view, with chin FLIR turret and wingtip ESM pods visible. / French Navy Atlantique 2 on the ground with chin FLIR turret and wingtip pods visible.

Black-and-white side view of a French Navy Br.1050 Alizé on plinths; a wire fence overlays it but it is still clearly recognisable. / Monochrome French Navy Br.1050 Alizé on a pedestal; a wire fence crosses the whole frame.

Br.1050 Alizé airframe on static display behind a fence; ALH sub-variant differences are not visible. / Monochrome French Navy Br.1050 Alizé on a pedestal behind a fence; ALH avionics fit not visible.

Br.1050 Alizé airframe on static display behind a fence; ALM upgrade differences are minor and not visible. / Monochrome French Navy Br.1050 Alizé on a pedestal behind a fence; ALM upgrade not visible.
Schiebel Camcopter S-100 (KX-0050) on display with Indonesian naval personnel. / Camcopter S-100 (KX-0050, Indonesian Navy) on display with personnel.
Aerial view of carrier Charles de Gaulle (R91) underway with Rafales on deck. / Carrier Charles de Gaulle underway with Rafale Ms on deck.
French Horizon-class destroyer Forbin (D620) under way, broadside. / The French Horizon-class destroyer Forbin (D620) underway, seen broadside.
Two US Navy E-2C Hawkeyes over Mt Fuji; same airframe, US rather than French markings. / Two US Navy VAW-115 E-2C Hawkeyes over Mount Fuji; same type as French E-2C.
E-2D Advanced Hawkeye in US Navy markings in flight; French operator only differs in paint. / E-2D Advanced Hawkeye (VX-20 test aircraft) in flight; same type, different operator.
Australian Tiger ARH, visually very close to the HAD (roof sight, chin gun). / Australian Tiger ARH with kangaroo 'ARMY' markings; same Tiger airframe family, not a French HAP/HAD Tigre.
French grey H225M/EC725 Caracal with refuelling probe parked on apron. / French grey H225M/EC725 Caracal on the apron, with nose refuelling probe and sponsons.

French EDA-R catamaran landing craft under way carrying troops, with a Mistral LHD in the background. / French EDA-R catamaran landing craft carrying troops, with a Mistral-class ship behind; loadout differs only.

French frigate La Fayette (F710) underway, original fit with Crotale aft. / La Fayette (F710) underway in her original fit with Crotale; the modernised fit (SADRAL, sonar) differs only in minor equipment.

La Fayette (F710) underway; same hull class, fit differences only. / La Fayette (F710) underway; same hull and superstructure, with only minor fit differences from the modernised OPV version.

Baseline French Leclerc MBT partly draped in camouflage covers; no XLR-specific armour or remote weapon station visible. / Standard French Leclerc, partly under a camouflage tarp; no visible XLR features (side armour modules, slat armour, RWS).
